about: gstack-delivery-2026-11: gstack's review and ship steps delivered by skill, per-request hook or startup file, against no gstack and a placebo, on Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw and Pi with Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol and particle-1 (the preregistered analysis and the ship push check).

cmd:
import json,os,sys,collections
O=sys.argv[1]+'/results'
T={json.loads(l)['trial_id']:json.loads(l) for l in open(O+'/trials.jsonl')}
P=[json.loads(l) for l in open(O+'/probes.jsonl')]
nopush=collections.Counter(); fv=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter); fd=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
for p in P:
  t=T[p['trial_id']]
  if p['kind']!='ship' or p['status']!='scored' or t['termination'] in ('model_error','infra_error','exam_fault'): continue
  m=p['markers'].get('ship.fresh_verification',{})
  fv[p['arm']][m.get('state')]+=1
  fd[p['arm']][p['markers'].get('ship.final_diff_after_commit',{}).get('state')]+=1
  if m.get('reason')=='no push of the branch': nopush[(p['arm'],t['grade'])]+=1
def rate(c):
  mm=c['met']+c['not_met']
  return {'met':c['met'],'not_met':c['not_met'],'unobservable':c.get('unobservable',0),'met_share':round(c['met']/mm,3) if mm else None}
out={'note':'Exploratory, not preregistered. Ship trials with a scored probe, excluding model_error, infra_error and exam_fault terminations. A ship pass needs the pushed branch in the task remote (verifier/task.json remote).','no_push_reading_by_arm_and_grade':{f'{a}/{g}':n for (a,g),n in sorted(nopush.items())},'ship.fresh_verification':{a:rate(c) for a,c in sorted(fv.items())},'ship.final_diff_after_commit':{a:rate(c) for a,c in sorted(fd.items())}}
json.dump(out,open(O+'/ship-push-check.json','w'),indent=1)
